//: Ainize MCP server — copy the block you need into your client's config and change the two paths.
//1: Claude Code (project): save as .mcp.json at the repo root. Cursor: ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Claude Desktop / Windsurf: the app's own config file. All four use this same shape.
//2: SECRETS: env values are stored in plain text by every one of these clients. Point at a shell variable you export elsewhere (${VAR}), or leave them out and start the server from a wrapper script that exports them.
//3: AINIZE_MCP_SESSION_BUDGET defaults to 0, which means the `buy` tool is not registered at all. Set it only when you intend this agent to be able to spend, and keep it small.

mcpServers.//ainize-http: Alternative: one server process shared by several clients. Start it with `node packages/mcp/dist/bin.js --http 3499` first. It refuses to start with a spending budget or apply/publish enabled unless you also pass --i-am-the-only-user, because a port is reachable by people who are not the operator.
